name: Pankajam Kottanath

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Pankajam Kottanath, published elsewhere as Pankajam Kottarath and K. Pankajam, writes poetry and fiction in English and Malayalam and translates from Malayalam into English. Her poetry collections include Whispering Waves, published by Writers Workshop in 2013. Her contributions to Setu also explore memory, belonging and the experience of moving between cultures.

In ‘Love And After’, intimacy meets the cruelty of public judgment. Images of a sea and a desert give way to a world where the lovers become both the accused and their own judges. The poem’s final movement imagines love surviving that judgment, turning an intimate story into a challenge to collective hypocrisy.
